search.label: Search inside run traces
search.help: All words must match, in steps, tool calls and their arguments, model errors, the answer and the grade. Use quotes for a phrase and field terms such as tool:, agent:, outcome:, benchmark:, version:. Example: tool:refund_order "all tests pass"
search.heading: Trace matches

maxim.desc: Send every finished run's trace to your Maxim log repository, and open runs in Maxim.
maxim.storedKey: Stored key ending in {{last4}}. Leave empty to keep it.
maxim.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Maxim? The stored key is removed and finished runs are no longer sent.
maxim.loadError: Could not load the Maxim connection

mismatches.hint: Steps where two records of the run disagree, such as the agent's own stream and the gateway log. They are not errors of the agent: hover a row to read the difference.
